description:
Look up any entity by symbol, slug, contract/wallet address, operator or vault name.

        Returns {entity_type, id, score, grade, confidence, report_hash,
        receipt_hash, links, receipt}. report_hash is the entity's latest
        attested report; receipt_hash is a deprecated alias of it. receipt
        is this answer's own receipt (check it at receipt.status). When
        nothing resolves returns {match: null, did_you_mean: [up to 5
        candidates], receipt} rather than an error.
name: entity_read
